resources.string: This zip has no NSMBU save (user/rp_personal_savedata.dat)
Save imported (the previous one is in %1$s)
Common key: choose the key again
Preparing the game for your Android device…
Disc key: choose the key again
Tap Details to see why. You can choose your game again or tap Continue.

Put the game in a folder of its own (for example Download/NSMBU) and choose that folder. Android doesn\'t allow choosing Download itself. A .wua archive or a .wud/.wux disc image is a single file and can be chosen from any folder.
This is the game\'s %1$s folder. Choose the folder one level up: the one that contains code, content and meta.
This folder doesn\'t contain the game. Choose the folder that contains code, content and meta.
The folder “%1$s” has code, content and meta, but not the files of New Super Mario Bros. U (code/red-pro2.rpx and meta/meta.xml). Check that your copy of the game is complete.
This folder has code, content and meta, but not the files of New Super Mario Bros. U (code/red-pro2.rpx and meta/meta.xml). Check that your copy of the game is complete.
This folder contains more than one game folder (%1$s). Choose the one you want.
Using the game folder “%1$s” inside the folder you chose.
Disc images need two keys; a Cemu keys.txt with common and disc lines covers both. Or use Cemu’s “Convert to compressed Wii U archive (.wua)” — no keys needed.
You can leave the app; setup continues in the background.
Setup continues by itself when the Android device is ready.
Tap Continue when you want to go on.
Paused: the Android device is too warm
Choose your extracted game folder on this device.
Pick the folder that contains code, content and meta (the same layout as on your PC). The app copies it privately, then Play uses that copy. You can also copy it over USB with nsmbu apk.
Tap Play, or choose a different folder.
Press Home on the controller or Back to open Settings
Touch controls. Hold the controller button to edit the layout.
Drag a control to move it. Select one, then change its size.
Tap Play to start the game.
Allow access to the chosen game again
Tap Start to prepare it for this Android device.
Choose your copy of the game: an extracted game folder, a Cemu .wua archive or a .wud/.wux disc image. The Android device prepares it once; this takes a few minutes.
